title: Ông, bà, cô, chú — Addressing more people

vocab.en: you/I, a woman your parent's age; also Miss/teacher
you/I, a man your parent's age

segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Before, first.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Trước.] [EN: After.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Sau.] [EN: After that, then.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Sau đó.] [EN: Supermarket.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Siêu thị.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: In Level 1 you learned] [VI: anh, chị, em.] [EN: Here are four more, for people older than you. For a man around your parent's age, use] [VI_F: Chú.] [EN: a high, rising tone. For a woman that age, use] [VI_F: Cô.] [EN: round your lips, a flat tone. For grandparent-aged people, an older man is] [VI_F: Ông.] [EN: and an older woman is] [VI_F: Bà.] [EN: a falling tone. Say grandfather-aged man.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ông.] [EN: Say it for a woman.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bà.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Greet an older gentleman politely.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ, xin chào ông.] [EN: Thank a woman your parent's age.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn cô.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. Address an older man, grandfather age.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Ông.] [EN: An older woman, grandmother age.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Bà.] [EN: A man your parent's age.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Chú.] [EN: A woman your parent's age.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Cô.] [EN: Thank a gentleman.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn ông.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Chú.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: A man your parent's age.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Bà.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: An older woman, grandmother age.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen. A young person greets an older couple.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_M: Dạ, con chào ông bà.] [EN: He called himself] [VI: con] [EN: which a young person uses with grandparent-aged people.] [VI_F: Chào con.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Greet a gentleman politely.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ, xin chào ông.] [EN: Thank a woman your parent's age.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn cô.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you describe your whole day. The preview phrase is] [VI: buổi trưa] [EN: which means midday, noon.]
